description: Read one authorized project's bounded context pack: state, TODOs, decisions, timeline, recent memories, and optional durable recall. Requires memory:read; it does not mutate project memories, and access is audit-logged. Use an exact project_id for a whole-project snapshot; otherwise use recall_context. max_items/max_tokens bound the whole pack; recent_hours affects only timeline; durable_query requires include_durable_context.

agent_id.description: Optional client-supplied agent label for memory attribution.

agent_instance_id.description: Optional stable, non-secret agent instance ID for per-client attribution.

bucket.description: Accessible bucket filter; % includes all accessible buckets.

durable_query.description: Query only for durable recall; ignored when include_durable_context is false.

include_durable_context.description: Include semantic durable recall; false omits that section.

max_tokens.description: Whole-pack approximate token budget from 1 to 50000.

output_json.description: True returns the full structured pack; false returns a text summary.

project_id.description: Exact authorized project ID; project names are not accepted.

recent_hours.description: Timeline lookback from 1 to 8760 hours; other sections are unaffected.

team_id.description: Optional exact authorized team focus; other team rows are excluded.

name: get_project_context

result.description: Human-readable text or JSON requested by output_json.
